item.title: The overlooked businesses making Americans rich
item.description:
The American Dream can feel farther away than ever. Housing is expensive, good jobs seem harder to find and the people getting rich seem to be concentrated in a handful of big cities. But some of America’s biggest fortunes are being built far from the spotlight: by auto dealers, contractors, beverage distributors and the owners of the unglamorous businesses that keep everyday life running. So who are these overlooked millionaires — and what do they tell us about opportunity in America?
Host Megan McArdle is joined by Owen Zidar, a professor at Princeton University and co-author of “The Everywhere Millionaire.” They discuss the hidden world of private-business wealth, why early work experience matters and how retiring boomers may create new opportunities for the next generation to buy and run America’s small businesses.
